done.instructions: The request in this transcript excerpt is fully completed, with no step the assistant said it would do still undone.

criteria.true: Every item in the last user request is done, and the final assistant message reports it as done. The message announces no next step (such as "next I will", "let me" or "I still need to"), no background work that is still running, and no failing test or check left unfixed. A question to the user counts as completion only when the task is already done and the question offers optional extra work. An answer to a pure question counts as completion when it answers it. A mention of optional follow-up work outside the request does not make the task incomplete.
criteria.false: Some item in the last user request is not done or not reported. Examples: the message says what the assistant will do next; it says work still runs in the background and the result is pending; it says a test, type check or other check still fails, even when it also claims to be done; it reports only part of the requested items; or it ends with a question the user must answer before the task can be finished, such as a choice between approaches.
